headline: Clinton order directs federal agencies to cut waste, recycle more, and consider the environment when buying goods.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order tells federal agencies to reduce waste and increase recycling. It also calls on the government to factor waste prevention and recycling into how it buys products and services. No summary was provided, so the specific rules and targets are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are directed to prevent waste, recycle, and change their purchasing practices.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that sell products to the federal government
who_it_affects.how: Government buying decisions may give more weight to recycled or less wasteful products.
